slices.desc: TBD-1/TBD-2 prototype: rewrite ORCHESTRATION+ENFORCEMENT in both spec shapes, verify Obsidian symlink, end at user decision
acceptance: ORCHESTRATION (4 reqs) and ENFORCEMENT (13 reqs: ENFORCEMENT-R-001, PACING-R-001..011, SEAL-R-001) each rendered in BOTH shapes: requirement-per-file and concept-per-file-with-sections
.groundwork/specs -> ../doc/specs symlink created and Obsidian confirmed to follow it (or fallback relative-link sample produced)
both shapes opened in Obsidian with screenshots of properties pane and backlinks
ENDS with an explicit user decision point recorded as a DECISION event resolving TBD-1 and TBD-2
no production spec files under doc/specs are modified - prototype output lives in a scratch dir

slices.desc: Capture gate/pacing/guard scenario corpus from CURRENT hooks before new implementation lands
acceptance: Corpus of recorded input/verdict pairs captured from the LEGACY hooks at HEAD covering stop-gate, pacing, and the PreToolUse guards
each scenario stores the full hook stdin payload plus the observed exit code and decision output, not a summary
corpus is committed as fixture data so it is replayable after legacy code is deleted
corpus includes at minimum one scenario per PACING-R-001..011 and ENFORCEMENT-R-001 and SEAL-R-001
capture harness invokes hooks by their registered path so the deployed invocation path is exercised

slices.desc: Enumerate all persisted artefact types with producers/consumers; classify durable vs ephemeral for gw migrate
acceptance: Every persisted artefact type under .groundwork/ and doc/specs/ is listed with its producing module and consuming modules resolved against HEAD
each artefact classified durable (migrates) or ephemeral (not migrated) with the charter D5 rule cited
the 6 modules that reference doc/specs/_generated are enumerated
output identifies which fields have no destination in the Markdown+frontmatter model - the lossy set - before migration is written

slices.desc: TRACER BULLET: shared Zod frontmatter schemas + file-layout contract + gray-matter/wikilink primitives that all later slices import
acceptance: One shared Zod schema module defines frontmatter for every note kind — motive, slice, gate, decision (MADR), ticket, requirement (D-13 hybrid: ears_pattern, verification_method), concept index, and the D-15 design note kinds (MOC, concept, flow, component, recipe, reference, glossary) — and is the single import point for CLI and hooks
file-layout contract documents the exact on-disk path for every note kind incl. the design/ folder IA, assets/ adjacency, and the tracker_path config indirection
decision-id normalization: schema accepts legacy D1..D8 and canonical D-n, emits canonical D-n
gray-matter round-trip proven by a test that parses and re-serializes a note with unusual YAML and byte-compares the result
surgical single-key frontmatter write patches only the target line range — test asserts untouched lines are byte-identical including comments and key order
wikilink formatter escapes # | ^ [ ] and strips .md — test covers each escape character
zod and gray-matter added as direct dependencies in package.json
NO other slice may define a frontmatter type — this slice owns src/gw/schema and src/gw/fm exclusively

slices.desc: gw binary skeleton: Bun single-binary build, command router, --json envelope on every command
acceptance: bun build produces a single self-contained gw binary and gw --help lists every command
every command accepts --json and emits a machine-parseable envelope on both success and failure
exit codes preserve the existing contract 0 success 1 operational failure 2 usage error
owns src/gw/cli and the build config only - does not touch store or hook modules

slices.desc: Motive charter, ticket, and decision notes as Markdown+frontmatter on the new parallel layout
acceptance: Charter, ticket, and decision notes read and write through the S1 schema with no local type definitions
decisions carry status and rationale as frontmatter properties and relations as wikilinks
TBD/TBR open items are represented as notes - note that TBD is NOT a journal event type today so the source is charter prose
writes land in the parallel directory per D5 so existing hooks keep working
owns src/gw/store/motive only

slices.desc: Slice-as-note, per-session gate note, and seal sidecar replacing the run ledger JSON
acceptance: Each slice is a note under its motive with session and wave frontmatter properties per D2
blocked_by and covers_ac are wikilink relations resolvable as Obsidian backlinks
the write-seal is a sidecar hash file NOT a frontmatter key so a human edit in Obsidian does not invalidate machine trust - test edits a note by hand and asserts the seal detects it
querying slices by session property reproduces what the ledger session_id field returns today
owns src/gw/store/slice, gate, seal only

slices.desc: gw migrate: lossless conversion of durable artefacts over the real corpus; ephemeral state untouched
acceptance: gw migrate --dry-run reports zero lossy conversions over the real motive corpus - note HEAD has 15 motive dirs not the 14 the charter states
round-trip test converts and converts back and byte-compares the semantic content for every motive
ephemeral state (per-session ledgers, seals, struggle tallies, open-items) is provably untouched - test asserts mtimes unchanged
lossy set identified in S0-INVENTORY is either handled or explicitly reported, never silently dropped
owns src/gw/migrate only

slices.desc: Port stop-gate/pacing/guard logic into gw; hooks become one-line shims invoking gw hook <name>
acceptance: Every hook registered in hooks/hooks.json is a one-line shim invoking gw hook <name>
shims are invoked by their registered bare path and are executable - assert the exec bit, do not test via node <path>
stop-gate reads slices by session property and the session gate note verdict per D2 rather than a ledger JSON file
pacing counts distinct waves among the session slices and preserves the PACING-R-001 default of budget 1 with exempt_kinds plan/diagnose/design/fog
NO gate/pacing/guard semantics change - this is a port, behavior deltas are defects not improvements

slices.desc: Parity suite replaying the S0 corpus against legacy and new implementations, diffing verdicts
acceptance: Suite feeds every recorded S0 scenario to BOTH the legacy hook path and the new gw hook path and asserts identical decision output and exit code
tests execute both surfaces - they MUST NOT assert on source text, and a source-text assertion is a rejection
a red-green bite proof is included: mutate one new-path decision and show the parity test fails
the suite runs unfiltered as part of the normal test command, not as a named-file run
any scenario where legacy and new legitimately differ is listed explicitly with a charter citation, never silently normalized

slices.desc: Migrate all 7 concepts / 55 requirement ids to the D-15 layout (index.md + requirements/ hybrid template + design/ folder IA + decisions/ + glossary.md); PILOT one concept first (stop-gate/enforcement) and re-run the S1-EVAL-BASELINE comprehension eval before/after; delete spec.yaml, constraints.md, _generated/; rewire the 5 consumer modules (spec-io, spec.mjs, spec-lint, spec-guard, traceability-adapter)
acceptance: All 7 concepts migrated to the shape chosen in S0-PROTO with every one of the 55 requirement ids preserved - no id renamed or dropped
doc/specs/_generated and every spec.yaml and constraints.md are absent

the 6 modules referencing _generated (hooks/lib/spec-io.mjs, hooks/lib/traceability-adapter.mjs, hooks/spec-lint.mjs, hooks/spec-guard.mjs, hooks/journal.mjs, hooks/spec.mjs) are updated - a repo-wide sweep is required, not a named-file edit list
each concept has an index.md carrying concept metadata in frontmatter - note this renames the existing README.md overview file
coverage is expressed as verifies wikilinks on slices and the Obsidian backlinks pane shows the coverage report

slices.desc: Manual Obsidian vault verification: notes, typed properties, graph view, slice-to-requirement link resolution
acceptance: Opening .groundwork/ as an Obsidian vault shows motives, slices, gates, and decisions as linked notes with typed properties in the properties pane
slice-to-requirement verifies links resolve with no unresolved-link placeholders
screenshot of graph view and of an open linked note captured as evidence
verification is manual per the charter AC-5 note - evidence is re-captured against the final build, never reused from an earlier build

slices.desc: Cut over from the parallel layout; retire legacy .mjs readers/writers and bin/ledger + bin/journal
acceptance: bin/ledger and bin/journal are removed and every caller invokes gw
the legacy .mjs reader/writer modules superseded by gw are deleted, not left dormant - deletion and replacement land in the SAME slice
file-extension audit of .groundwork/ after a representative session shows Markdown only, with .seal sidecar hash files the sole exemption
plugin.json, hooks.json, and model-registry.json remain JSON per D1
full unfiltered test suite is green against a HEAD baseline, and the baseline failure count is recorded before the slice starts

slices.desc: Round 3: ORCHESTRATION design.md with mermaid (state machine, stop-gate flow, slice data shape) to judge the requirements/design split in Obsidian
acceptance: design.md exists with ≥3 rendering mermaid blocks each wikilinking the requirements it realizes
REVIEW-3.md with review procedure and blank Decision

slices.desc: Per-aspect survey of design-spec conventions (data shapes, flows, state, interfaces, decisions, NFRs) across Kiro/Spec Kit/arc42/C4/RFC/OpenAPI; recommend a shape per aspect
acceptance: ticket with per-aspect recommendation table, each row citing ≥1 source
explicit mermaid/Obsidian renderability verdict per aspect

slices.desc: Design the dogfooding eval loop: how spec-shape changes are evaluated by using the new flow on groundwork itself (metrics, mechanisms, prior art)
acceptance: ticket proposing ≥3 measurable signals with capture mechanism each
names what would make a shape change a regression

slices.desc: Survey recognized design-documentation patterns (design-system component pages, Diataxis, Obsidian MOC, Storybook, cookbook/recipes, arc42 views) and recommend the design-folder IA per aspect
acceptance: ticket with IA recommendation citing ≥4 real design-system/doc sources
page template per note type

slices.desc: Round 4: ORCHESTRATION design as a folder of presented notes (MOC index, concepts, flows, components w/ visual embeds, specs, recipes) per recognized patterns
acceptance: design/ folder with MOC index and ≥5 note types rendering in Obsidian
REVIEW-4.md with procedure and blank Decision

slices.desc: Eval minimal slice (no doc/specs writes): compute LINT_DRIFT + struggle-signal + AC-retraction baselines from existing journals and record them as journal events; author the stop-gate agent-comprehension eval suite (claude plugin eval, --ablation none); document the A/B procedure S4-SPEC-MIGRATE runs on its pilot concept
acceptance: baseline numbers for ≥3 signals recorded as journal events with their capture command
comprehension eval suite (5–8 questions answerable from the spec alone) runs green on the CURRENT stop-gate spec with --ablation none and its score is recorded
no file under doc/specs modified

slices.desc: Wire the ledger/journal command vocabulary in gw to the S2 stores (replace NOT_IMPLEMENTED stubs): status/add/set/complete/rm/show/view/gate/abandon/fog/frontier/claim/await-human/autopilot/scope-token and journal append/show/compile, all with --json
acceptance: every stub from S2-CLI is replaced by a store-backed implementation - no NOT_IMPLEMENTED remains in the router
each command's semantics match bin/ledger and bin/journal help text - a table test runs the same scenario through the legacy CLI and gw and compares normalized output
token/seal authority for gate/complete/abandon/autopilot is enforced via the S2-SLICE seal - test proves a write without authority is rejected
owns src/gw/cli/commands only
